metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: IMUYIB crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C280 H378 Eu42 O238,42(C4 H10 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu2 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu3 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu4 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu5 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu6 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu7 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu8 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu9 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu10 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu11 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu12 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu13 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu14 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu15 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu16 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu17 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu18 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu19 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu20 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu21 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu1A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu2A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu3A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu4A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu5A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu6A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu7A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu8A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu9A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu10A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu11A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu12A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu13A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu14A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu15A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu16A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu17A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu18A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu19A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu20A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu21A (Eu) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 70 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.636-4.030 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 92.87-111.65°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula Eu42L14(OAc)82(OH)30 (L = deprotonated ortho-vanillin). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 82 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 30 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
